messages:
harry: Heads up: prod eu-west1 is seeing burst 429s on route /v1/embed for small requests. Suspect recent rate-limiter tweak. I pushed a hotfix image that relaxes token bucket for short requests. Need expedited rollout — prefer toggling feature-flag + quick prod canary skip. @jess @natalie can you triage?
jess: Which flag? can we A/B toggle instead of full deploy?
harry: Flag name: embeds.rate_limit_short_payload_patch. New image: redwood/embed:v2.4.1-rlfix-174556. Patch is safe, no schema.
deploy-bot: Canary required by policy. Override allowed with 2 eng + 1 SRE approval.
charlie: I'll run the smoke and flag toggle in staging first. Also prepare rollback steps.
charlie: staging smoke started. smoke script: `scripts/smoke_embed_short.sh --region eu-west1` TTL ~2m.
charlie: staging smoke OK. 0 429s in 3m window, kv warm.
natalie: Monitoring prod traffic now. Metrics: https://dash.internal/embeds/traffic?window=5m shows 6% small-payload 429s concentrated on nodepool-3.
jess: I can +1 for override if SRE signs off. oncall-sre, can you approve?
oncall-sre: I'll watch, prefer feature flag toggle approach. If we toggle, ensure automated rollback if error-rate increases > 0.8%.
harry: Plan: deploy image pinned, enable flag for 5% of hosts for 10m, if stable scale to 100% over 3m. Rollback: disable flag + `kubectl set image` back to redwood/embed:v2.4.0 if issues. No DB changes.
jess: +1. :white_check_mark:
oncall-sre: +1, will set alert and run quick synthetic requests.
harry: Triggering expedite. command: ```/deploy --service embeds --image redwood/embed:v2.4.1-rlfix-174556 --target staging --pin --notes "hotfix: relax token-bucket for small payloads"```
deploy-bot: Deploy queued to staging. Policy=canary_required but override path pending.
deploy-bot: Staging deploy succeeded. sha=c3f4d5e.
charlie: Toggling flag on 5% hosts in prod (shipctl feature enable).
charlie: flag toggled. Observing for 10m.
jess: Watching metrics and error budget.
oncall-sre: Synthetic load ok. Error-rate dropped from 6% -> 0.3% on flagged hosts.
harry: Good. Rolling to 25% then 100% with 2m stabilization windows. command: ```/deploy --service embeds --image redwood/embed:v2.4.1-rlfix-174556 --target prod --pin --rollout 100% --notes "expedite: rate-limit hotfix + feature-flag rollout"```
deploy-bot: Rollout started. Auto-rollback if small-payload 429s > 0.8% for 2m.
natalie: If we see surge elsewhere revert flag first, then image rollback.
charlie: Prod at 100% now. No spike. 429s reduced cluster-wide to 0.2% in 5m.
harry: Publishing release notes stub: https://docs.internal/releases/174556-rlfix  will finalize after 30m watch.
oncall-sre: I'll keep alert muted for noise and escalate if error-rate creeps above threshold.
jess: Great work. Closing thread after monitoring window. If anything odd ping oncall DM.
